item.title: Innolux posts 4th straight profit, sees consumer display slip in 3Q26
item.summary: Innolux said net profit after tax reached NT$4.65 billion (US$146.3 million) in the second quarter of 2026, marking a fourth consecutive quarter in the black. The panel maker warned that display demand will soften in the third quarter as brand customers pulled in orders earlier in the first half.
